# @sharadox/graphical-user-interface-web-library

> One generic React 19 component library. Every value has one source (CSS custom properties written by InterfaceStyle from defineInterface), everything else is derived with var(); brands only configure it.

- /interface-configuration: defineInterface({ colorStyles?, inheritColorStyles?, defaultColorStyle? ("inherit"), colors?: { [name]: { rgb: { white, black }, gradient?: name[], on?, hover?, active? (hover), background?, border? (background) } | { of: name | { white, black }, gradient?, on?, hover?, active?, background?, border? } }, cornerStyles?, defaultCornerStyle?, lineStyles?, defaultLineStyle?, scale?, breakpoints?, sizes?, defaultSize?, positions?: { [name]: { x | inline, y } (0–1) }, defaultGlowPosition? (bottom), values? }) → InterfaceConfiguration; DEFAULT_INTERFACE; isReference(color); CURSOR_POSITION. Colors: index (default of every component: of middleground, on background, hover/background/border foreground), middleground (no exceptions), foreground, background, brand, information, success, warn, error, rainbow, the hues. Positions: center top bottom left right top-left top-right bottom-left bottom-right start end start-start start-end end-start end-end top-start top-end bottom-start bottom-end
- /style-sheet: interfaceStyleSheet(configuration) → CSS. Variables per color X: --X-color-rgb (source), --X-{on,hover,active,background,border,focus}-color-rgb (parts), --X-color-rgb-alpha, --X-color, --X-{on,hover,active,background,focus}-color, --X-transparent-color(-rgb-alpha) (background at 12.5%), --X-transparent-hover-color, --X-transparent-active-color, --X-border-color, --X-color-paint; --focus-color(-rgb) (the page's ring); gradient colors (rainbow: red→yellow→green→cyan→blue→magenta, flat = foreground) add --X-color-gradient, --X-transparent(-hover|-active)-color-gradient; flags --X-color-gradient-weight (0%|100%), --X-color-gradient-display (none|block), --X-text-fill, --X-text-clip. A piece's color: --current-* (same names). Shared: --scale-{0,4,8,12,14,16,24,32,64,128}, --breakpoint-{640,960,1280}, --color-rgb-alpha, --transparent-color-rgb-alpha (12.5%), --transparent-hover-color-rgb-alpha, --transparent-active-color-rgb-alpha, --disabled-opacity, --line-thickness, --line-style, --corner-radius, --quick-duration (0.1s), --duration (0.25s), --easing, --glass-blur, --current-{minimum-size,font-size,font-weight,field-font-weight,section-padding}, --wrapper-width, --wrapper-padding, --gradient-angle (90deg), --line-solid (1|0), --focus-thickness, --focus-offset (inside the edge), --glow-range (128), --glow-overflow (8), --glow-size, --glow-opacity, --glow-breathe-duration, --glow-float-duration, --glow-press-scale; a glow layer's --glow-x, --glow-y (0–1). Attributes: data-style-color (white|black|inherit), data-style-corner (square|rounded-square|circle), data-style-line (line|dotted|dashed), data-color, data-size (small|medium|large), data-variant, data-direction, data-justify, data-align, data-text-align, data-gap, data-padding, data-glow-position (any position | cursor), data-glow-boundary (outside|inside), data-modifications (space-separated: glass glow); each also as data-<name>-<breakpoint>.
- /interface-style: InterfaceStyle({ configuration }) — <style> with the sheet, in the root layout's head
- /responsive: responsiveAttributes(name, value | { base?, [width]: value }, fallback?) → { [data-name(-width)]: string }
- /box-axis: boxAxes(scale) → Axis[] ({ attribute, values: { [name]: { rest, hover?, active? } } }); VARIANT_AXIS, DIRECTION_AXIS, JUSTIFY_AXIS, ALIGN_AXIS, TEXT_ALIGN_AXIS, BOX_INITIAL_VALUES
- /box: Box({ as?, variant?: filled|outlined|transparent|inline, color?, colorStyle?, corner?, line?, size?, direction?: left-to-right|right-to-left|top-to-bottom|bottom-to-top, justify?, align?, textAlign?, wrap?, gap?, padding? (each Responsive), prefix?, suffix?, square?, interactive?, state?: index (default, follows the pointer)|enabled|hover|active|loading|disabled (set states stay; active and loading look pressed, cursor default), modifications?: ("glass"|"glow")[] (default glass), glowPosition?, glowBoundary?: outside (default)|inside, ...element }); flex, centered both axes and text by default; filled and transparent have no border (its thickness is padding, so every variant is the same size), outlined parts its sections with a border; the focus ring is inside the edge (brand; foreground on a brand fill; background on a foreground fill); glow outside renders a GlowLayer sibling right after the box, inside its first child
- /glow-layer: GlowLayer({ attributes, boundary? }) — "use client"; a light sized to the box that breathes and floats while on screen, rests at --glow-x/--glow-y (hidden at cursor until the pointer is near), glides to the pointer within --glow-range (followPointerPosition from pointer-web-library), held to the edges (+ --glow-overflow outside), swells while the box is pressed; outside: anchored after its box (CSS anchor positioning), under it; inside: the box's first child, clipped, over its fill and under its content
- /spinner: Spinner({ className? }) — 8 bars, clockwise trail, 1em, aria-hidden
- /button: Button({ variant? (filled), color? (index), size?, corner?, line?, colorStyle?, state?, loading?, disabled?, icon?, square?, prefix?, suffix?, ...button }) or with href: next/link Link (or link component), disabled link has no href and aria-disabled; "use client"
- /button-axis: BUTTON_AXES { variant, state, size } (server-safe)
- /choice: Choice({ label, options: { value, label }[], value, onChange, size?, color? (index), className? }) — radiogroup, roving tab stop, arrows/Home/End
- /interface-styles: interfaceStyles(configuration) → style-web-library StyleConfiguration (groups color [inherit = system], corner, line)
- /style-switch: StyleSwitch({ configuration, group, label, labels?, size?, className? }) — Choice over a style group, remembered
- /box: also field?: boolean (form-control box: text cursor, field font weight, focus-within ring, lines between sections)
- /field: Field({ label, hideLabel?, hint?, error?, id?, className?, children: ({ id, aria-describedby?, aria-invalid? }) => node })
- /text-field: TextField({ label, hideLabel?, hint?, error? (color → error), prefix?, suffix?, variant? (outlined), color? (index), size?, corner?, line?, colorStyle?, state?, multiline? (textarea, rows 3), ...input or textarea attributes })
- /toggle-mark: ToggleMark({ type: "checkbox" | "radio", label, checked, onChange(checked), state?, ...look, ...input }) — native input over a square Box (outlined → filled)
- /checkbox: Checkbox({ label, checked?, defaultChecked?, onChange?(checked), size? (medium), color? (index), disabled?, state?, ...input }) — "use client"
- /radio-group: RadioGroup({ label, options: { value, label }[], name?, value?, defaultValue?, onChange?(value), disabled?, error?, state?, ...look }) — role radiogroup, round marks; "use client"
- /switch: Switch({ label, checked?, defaultChecked?, onChange?(checked) → void | Promise<boolean | void> (false flips back), disabled?, state?, ...look (corner circle, size medium) }) — role switch; "use client"
- /wrapper: Wrapper(box properties) — inline-size 100%, max 1280 including its padding-inline 16, centered; use it only where content must sit within the page's width (full-width lines stay outside)
- /skip-link: SkipLink({ label, href? ("#main") }) — the first link in the body, to the main content; hidden until focused by keyboard
- /card: Card({ title?, headingLevel? (2), description?, action?, children, ...box }) — outlined index article, title in the active color (the fill's text color when filled), padding 24, action centered beside the content, wraps under it
- /separator: Separator({ orientation? (horizontal | vertical), color? (index), line?, className? }) — <hr> in the color's border color
- /badge: Badge(box properties) — span, filled index medium, inline
- /avatar: Avatar({ name, src?, size? (medium), color? (index), corner? (circle), colorStyle?, line?, className? }); initials(name) — img, or initials on a filled box when missing or failing; "use client"
- /field: the label's id is the control's id + "-label"
- /listbox: Listbox({ id (options: id-<index>), labelledBy, options: { value, label }[], chosen, active, onActive(index), onChoose(index), empty? }) — absolute panel under its anchor
- /select: Select({ label, hideLabel?, hint?, error?, options, value?, defaultValue?, onChange?(value), name? (hidden input), placeholder?, disabled?, state?, ...look }) — button role=combobox + Listbox; arrows/Home/End/Enter/Space/Tab/Escape/letters; "use client"
- /combobox: Combobox({ …Select's, placeholder?: string, empty? }) — input role=combobox aria-autocomplete=list, filters with matches(label, typed) (case- and accent-insensitive); "use client"
- /number-field: NumberField({ label, hint?, error?, value?, defaultValue?, onChange?(number | undefined), min?, max?, step? (1), name?, disabled?, decreaseLabel, increaseLabel, state?, ...look }) — minus/plus square buttons as prefix/suffix, clamps on blur; "use client"
- /dialog: Dialog({ open, onClose, title, closeLabel, children }) — native modal <dialog>, Escape/backdrop/close button, leaves with its opening animation reversed; "use client"
- /tip: Tip({ text, label }) — question-mark Button, role=tooltip bubble on hover/focus/tap, Escape hides; "use client"
- /notification: NotificationProvider({ label, dismissLabel, duration? (5000) }), useNotification().notify(message, tone?: "success" | "information" | "warn" | "error") — fixed region top right below --bar-height, max 4, errors are alerts and stay twice as long; "use client"
- /skeleton: Skeleton({ label, shape?: "lines" | "card" | "list" | "profile" | "cards", lines? (3), rows? (3), height? }) — role=status
- /skeleton-value: SkeletonValue({ label?, width? ("8ch"), circle? }) — inline shimmering shape
- /copy-button: CopyButton({ value, label, copiedLabel, onCopied? }) — outlined index medium Button; "use client"
- /code-boxes: CodeBoxes({ label, digitLabel, ofLabel, name?, length? (6), onComplete?(code), invalid?, disabled?, describedBy?, autoFocus? }) — one large outlined field Box per digit; paste fills all; Backspace/Delete clear; "use client"
- /navigation: Navigation({ brand, label, links: { href, label, current? }[], actions?, menuLabel, closeLabel, collapse?: 640 | 960 (default) | 1280, className? }) — sticky glass header spanning the screen, its content in a Wrapper; below collapse a menu button (icon menu/close) opens a fixed menu under the bar with the links (large) and actions; useMenu from menu-web-library; "use client"
- /tabs: Tabs({ label, tabs: { value, label, content }[], value?, defaultValue?, onChange?, color? (index), size?, className? }) — tablist (roving tabindex, arrows wrap, Home/End), chosen tab filled, tabpanel labelled by its tab; "use client"
- /accordion: Accordion({ items: { value, title, content }[], multiple?, open?, defaultOpen?, onChange?(open[]), headingLevel? (3), variant? (outlined), color? (index), corner?, line?, className? }) — heading > button aria-expanded, region inert when closed, grid-rows 0fr→1fr transition; "use client"
- /date-picker: DatePicker({ label, hint?, error?, value?, defaultValue?, onChange?(yyyy-mm-dd), name?, min?, max?, locale? ("en"), weekStart? (1), today?, placeholder?, previousLabel, nextLabel, disabled?, state?, ...look }); parseDay(text) → { year, month (0-based), day } | undefined; formatDay(day); monthDays(year, month, weekStart) → weeks of yyyy-mm-dd — role=dialog calendar, role=grid, arrows/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown/Enter/Escape, out-of-range days aria-disabled; "use client"
- /button: state="disabled" alone is aria-disabled (focusable, clicks refused); disabled makes it natively disabled; state active or loading also refuses clicks; default state index
